messages.subject: Query about Sunrise-set calculations
parts:
Does DeducerSpatial support use of maptools ::sunriset to generate a
data set of these times based on input of X-Y locations?
What I will need to create is the "reciprocal" of day length to derive
the length of nights to standardize a DF data set for each sampling
location with nocturnal activity times of bats.

Bruce
